q: I was charged but my order is not showing
a: Payments can take a few minutes to appear. Check your email (including spam) for a confirmation. If nothing arrives within an hour, open a ticket with the payment reference from your receipt and we will trace it.

q: I need an invoice or receipt
a: Reply on your ticket with your order reference and the name you want on the invoice, and we will send a receipt within one working day.

q: I cannot log in or forgot my password
a: Check that you are using the email address you signed up with. If you still cannot get in, open a ticket from that email address and we will help you regain access.

q: Something is not working as expected
a: Try refreshing the page or using a different browser first. If the problem remains, tell us what you clicked, what you expected, what happened instead, and attach a screenshot.
